resolvable.question: publicTrade fields; cancel-vs-fill discriminator in book stream
resolvable.answer: publicTrade carries T, s, S (aggressor side), v, p, L, i, BT (block trade), seq. Orderbook carries u (update id), seq, cts (matching-engine ts, correlates with trades), ts. size=0 deletes a level, u=1 means service restart. No direct cancel/fill flag: Decision 5 confirmed, refined by aggressor-side filter and BT exclusion.

resolvable.question: hftbacktest Rust API and input format
resolvable.answer: Native Rust crate on crates.io, MSRV 1.90+. Input: 8 fields ev, exch_ts, local_ts, px, qty, order_id, ival, faval; flags DEPTH_EVENT / TRADE_EVENT / DEPTH_SNAPSHOT_EVENT / DEPTH_CLEAR_EVENT / BUY_EVENT / SELL_EVENT; exch_ts must be earlier than local_ts.
